decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposal, because of its position, design and appearance, would relate well to its site and would not harm neighbours' living conditions or the appearance of the Cranford Village Conservation Area. The development is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan, and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No.60 Firs Drive.
description: Retention of a single storey side and rear extension to house.
